policy: A floor is measured against a denominator discovered from source, never curated. A floor may only move upward, in a pull request that also names the surface it improved; the gate never raises its own floor. A run that measures below a committed floor is a release blocker, because the only thing that makes 'autonomous' safe is that a generator which silently loses a section cannot pass.
measurement: covered counts facts whose exact name appears in a generated page of the reference locale; a page that dropped a fact because the model's prose about it was discarded does not count as covering it.

resources.denominator: every name: entry of frontend/src/components/Resource/Definition.tsx (72 at the ADR-0001 anchor)
resources.note: Raised when #1600's API reference pages land; 0 is the honest floor of a pipeline that generates no resource page yet.

models.denominator: every models.Model subclass of backend/*/models*.py (55 at the ADR-0001 anchor)
models.note: V-2 and V-3 are met by the generated ERD of each app, which #1599 owns.

relations.denominator: every ForeignKey, OneToOneField and ManyToManyField of backend/*/models*.py (178 at the ADR-0001 anchor)

settings.denominator: every module-level uppercase assignment of backend/MrMap/settings.py, distinct names (204 measured on today's develop; 158 at the ADR-0001 anchor, which grew with the tree)

commands.denominator: every backend/*/management/commands/*.py that is not __init__.py (9 at the ADR-0001 anchor)

tasks.denominator: every task decorator under backend/*/tasks/ (35 at the ADR-0001 anchor)

services.denominator: every service key of each committed docker-compose*.yml (11 base and 12 dev at the ADR-0001 anchor; 32 across all committed variants today)

features.denominator: every .feature file under backend/tests/behave/features (97 at the ADR-0001 anchor)
features.note: V-8 is reported rather than enforced until #1602 supplies browser scenarios; an enforced floor nobody can raise yet would be a lie, so the row is measured and named instead.
